prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.dependenciesValid = function(nodes, edges)
Behavior: Return true exactly when node names are unique, every directed edge endpoint is declared, and the directed dependency graph is acyclic. Empty input is valid.
Visible example: nodes [parse, build, ship] with parse->build and build->ship is valid; adding ship->parse makes it invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: exports.dependenciesValid=(n,e)=>{const d=new Map;for(const x of n){if(d.has(x))return false;d.set(x,0)}const g=new Map;for(const [a,b]of e){if(!d.has(a)||!d.has(b))return false;(g.get(a)||g.set(a,[]).get(a)).push(b);d.set(b,d.get(b)+1)}const q=[...d].filter(x=>x[1]===0).map(x=>x[0]);let seen=0;while(q.length){const x=q.pop();seen++;for(const y of g.get(x)||[]){d.set(y,d.get(y)-1);if(d.get(y)===0)q.push(y)}}return seen===n.length}
